newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Top British drug official visits Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Top British drug official visits Colombia.

text.p: A top British drug official met senior Colombian officials on Thursday as part of his first fact-finding tour to South America.
Derek Plumbly, the newly-appointed international drugs coordinator, met Defence Minister Juan Carlos Esguerra and Foreign Minister Maria Emma Mejia on Thursday, a British embassy spokesman said.

Plumbly, who arrived here late on Wednesday and will leave on Saturday, also met representatives of the Colombian state security department DAS, the prosecutor's office and the national anti-drug unit.
On Friday, the British official will visit the Colombian government's U.S-backed coca leaf and heroin poppy eradication programmes in either eastern Guaviare province or central Huila province.
Plumbly, who was named to the post less than a month ago when it was created, will meet National Police director Gen. Rosso Jose Serrano on Friday.
He arrived in Colombia from the United States, where he met the assistant U.S. secretary of state for international narcotics and law enforcement affairs, Robert Gelbard.
